claims.evidence: Xbox logo confirmed on console in photos 0 and 1, but exact model (One vs Series S/X) and 'UK' origin are not readable from the images.
Photo 0 and 2 both show two wireless controllers, one white one blue.
Top and side views look clean in photos 0-1, but bottom, back, and close-up scuff/dent shots are not shown.

claims.claim: Comes with Fc26 Package and other items
claims.evidence: No game disc, case, or extra accessories are visible in any photo.
Internal state cannot be assessed from external photos; no screw/seal close-ups provided.
Requires a power-on/running test; photos show the console off.
Ports are visible (USB, disc slot) but none are shown in active use.
Controllers appear to be standard Xbox controllers but no packaging or serial match is shown to confirm they are original to this console.
No receipt or document appears in any of the three photos.
